# OntoCoDec Literature Map
# Generated: 2026-05-13
# Scope: Constrained Decoding for IE / Schema-Guided IE / Type Constraint Enforcement (2020-2026)

novelty_assessment:
  claim: "Compile ontology domain/range axioms into decoding-time semantic constraints (LogitsProcessor) for LLM-based IE"
  verdict: "Novel — no prior work does this"
  gap_table:
    - level: "Syntactic (valid JSON)"
      ie_task: true
      decode_time: true
      prior_work: "GCD (EMNLP'23), XGrammar, Outlines, SGLang"
    - level: "Vocabulary (valid entity/relation names)"
      ie_task: true
      decode_time: true
      prior_work: "GENRE (ICLR'21), iNERD (SLT'24), AdaKGC (EMNLP'23)"
    - level: "Structural (generation order)"
      ie_task: true
      decode_time: true
      prior_work: "ATG (AAAI'24), JoinER-BART (TASLP'23), EnriCo (2024)"
    - level: "Semantic (domain/range type compatibility)"
      ie_task: false  # <-- THE GAP
      decode_time: false
      prior_work: "NONE for IE"
    - level: "Semantic (type checking)"
      ie_task: false  # code gen only
      decode_time: true
      prior_work: "MGD (NeurIPS'23), Synchromesh (NeurIPS'22), PLDI'25"
    - level: "Semantic (ontology compliance)"
      ie_task: true  # KG construction
      decode_time: false  # post-hoc only
      prior_work: "RELATE (2025), ODKE+ (Apple 2025), OntoLogX (2025)"
  framing: >
    OntoCoDec brings type-constrained generation — previously applied only to
    programming languages — to information extraction, by compiling IE ontology
    axioms into decoding-time semantic constraints that prevent, rather than
    detect, type violations.

most_relevant_papers:
  - id: pldi2025_type_constrained_codegen
    title: "Type-Constrained Code Generation via Prefix Automata"
    venue: PLDI
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2504.09246"
    method: "Compiles type systems into prefix automata for token-level logits masking during code generation. Reduces compilation errors >50%."
    relation: "Closest analog — same mechanism (type system → automaton → logits mask) but for programming language types, not IE ontology types."
    category: competitor_analog
    must_cite: true

  - id: mgd_neurips2023
    title: "Monitor-Guided Decoding of Code LMs with Static Analysis of Repository Context"
    venue: NeurIPS
    year: 2023
    method: "Uses static analysis monitors to enforce type-checking during code generation. SantaCoder-1.1B + MGD outperforms text-davinci-003."
    relation: "Type checking at decode time for code; OntoCoDec does type checking at decode time for IE."
    category: competitor_analog
    must_cite: true

  - id: synchromesh_neurips2022
    title: "Synchromesh: Reliable Code Generation from Pre-trained Language Models"
    venue: NeurIPS
    year: 2022
    method: "Constrained Semantic Decoding (CSD) enforcing syntax + types + scope simultaneously for code generation."
    relation: "Pioneer of semantic constraints at decode time. Foundational reference."
    category: foundational
    must_cite: true

  - id: geng_emnlp2023
    title: "Grammar-Constrained Decoding for Structured NLP Tasks without Finetuning"
    venue: EMNLP
    year: 2023
    method: "Input-dependent CFGs for NER, RE, entity disambiguation. Syntactic constraints only."
    relation: "Direct precursor for constrained decoding in IE, but no semantic constraints."
    category: precursor
    must_cite: true

  - id: odke_apple2025
    title: "ODKE+: Ontology-Driven Knowledge Extraction at Scale"
    venue: arXiv (Apple)
    year: 2025
    method: "Ontology snippet prompting + Grounder LLM post-validation. 98.8% precision on 19M facts."
    relation: "Production-scale ontology-guided IE, but post-processing not decode-time. Key baseline."
    category: competitor_baseline
    must_cite: true

  "raw": "调研完成。三个维度共覆盖 40+ 篇论文，核心结论：

### Novelty 确认

**OntoCoDec 的核心创新点成立** — 没有先前工作在 LLM 解码时对 IE 任务执行 ontology domain/range type constraints。

Gap 结构：
| 约束层级 | IE 任务? | 解码时? | 现有工作 |
|---------|---------|--------|---------|
| 句法 (valid JSON) | ✓ | ✓ | GCD, XGrammar, Outlines |
| 词汇 (valid type names) | ✓ | ✓ | GENRE, iNERD, AdaKGC |
| **语义 (domain/range 类型兼容性)** | **✗** | **✗** | **空白 ← OntoCoDec** |
| 语义 (类型检查) | 仅代码生成 | ✓ | MGD, Synchromesh, PLDI'25 |
| 语义 (ontology 合规) | KG 构建 | 仅后处理 | RELATE, ODKE+, OntoLogX |

### 最近似工作 (must differentiate)
1. **PLDI'25 Type-Constrained Code Gen** — 同机制（type system → automaton → logits mask）但用于编程语言
2. **MGD (NeurIPS'23)** — 代码生成的解码时类型检查
3. **ODKE+ (Apple'25)** — 产品级 ontology-guided IE，但用后处理而非解码约束

### 需注意的风险
- **CRANE (ICML'25)**: 严格约束可能降低推理质量
- **Grammar-Aligned Decoding (NeurIPS'24)**: naive masking 会扭曲 token 分布

### 产出文件
- `artifacts/literature_map.yaml` — 结构化文献地图 + novelty 评估 + 引用建议（16 篇 must-cite）
- `artifacts/literature_survey_constrained_decoding_ie.md` — 维度 1 详细报告
- `artifacts/literature_survey_ontology_constrained_ie.md` — 维度 2+3 详细报告
- `memory.md` — 已更新关键结论"
}

| 实验 | 已处理 | 状态 | GPU 占用 |

## Part 2: SciERC 对比结果 (minimal vs schema_informed)

**核心指标 — Domain/Range violation rate 下降 62.4%：15.37% → 5.78%**

| 指标 | minimal | schema_informed | 变化 |
|------|---------|-----------------|------|
| D/R violation rate | 15.37% | 5.78% | **-62.4%** |

| Entity type violation | 0.40% | 0.00% | -100% |

Per-relation 改进最大：Feature-of (-22.3pp), Part-of (-22.5pp), Compare (-14.8pp)。唯一退步的是 Evaluate-for (+5.8pp)。

McNemar 检验四类 violation 全部统计显著 (p<0.01)。

## 产出

1. `compare_prompts.py` 已部署到服务器，支持 SciERC/DocRED 两个数据集，包含聚合对比和 McNemar 检验
2. `outputs/violation_report_schema.json` — schema_informed violation report
